records.text: An anonymous email tipster said they thought there was no room for doubt that a photographed shard showed the USB logo from Charlie Kirk's RØDE microphone.
records.speaker: Anonymous RØDE USB-logo image tipster

appearances.snippet: They wrote, dear Candace and team, I'm watching your show from earlier today. I'm in France and I had to stop watching when you showed the shards after reading that email. I quickly spotted the USB logo on the shard at the 15 minute, 30 second mark. The one. ... I think there's no room for doubt here. It's clearly the USB logo and or icon game over.

verification.notes: The transcript verifies that an anonymous email writer made the USB-logo identification. Current RODE documentation shows the device and its USB markings, but the private email attachment and photographed shard lack independent authentication, scale, chain of custody, and forensic comparison. The shard identity cannot be verified.
